bias.en: Uptrend · cleared $265, closed at the day's low
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 突破 $265，收于全日低点

read.en: Amazon rose 2.9% on Nov 9 to $266.93, trading $266.92–275.31 and closing at the low. It is above every rising average: the 5-day ($260.63), 10-day ($254.06), 30-day ($254.41), 100-day ($252.81) and 200-day ($244.08). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 4 and above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($233.58), and RSI is 59.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月9日上涨 2.9%，收于 $266.93，盘中区间 $266.92–275.31，收于全日低点。股价位于所有上行均线上方：5 日（$260.63）、10 日（$254.06）、30 日（$254.41）、100 日（$252.81）和 200 日均线（$244.08）。MACD 自 11月4日起位于信号线上方且在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$233.58），RSI 为 59。

read.en: The close cleared the $263.9–265.3 resistance (Nov 4 low, Oct 20 high), now support, though the day faded from $275.31. Resistance is $271.5–275.3 (Nov 4, 5 and 9 highs), then $278.6 (May 5 high) and $287.2 (52-week high). Support is $263.9–265.3, then $258.5–260.6 (Nov 6 low, 5-day) and $252.8–254.4 (10, 30 and 100-day). A close above $275.3 would target $278.6; below $263.9, $258.5–260.6.

r.en: Nov 4 high $271.49; Nov 5 high $273.23; Nov 9 high $275.31
